info.name: Mazadat API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Mazadat mobile/API backend, generated from the live Laravel route list (php artisan route:list --path=api) on 2026-08-26.

Auth: most endpoints require `x-api-key` (project API key) and, where noted, `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`. Set `Accept-Language` to `ar` or `en`.

Auction item transfer: GET transferable endpoints only preview/validate transferable items and do not perform a transfer; only POST transfer performs the actual transfer. See the 'Auction Item Transfer' folder.
